product_one_liner.value: Qubrid provides GPU cloud and managed AI infrastructure plus a single API for inference on open models, for developers, researchers, and enterprises building and scaling AI workloads.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes GPU-as-a-service and a unified API for open-model inference, with cloud or on-premises deployment; it names developers, researchers, and enterprises as users.

pricing_page.notes: The cited page is Qubrid AI’s public pricing page and describes its pricing as transparent.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company homepage includes a Lern.Law testimonial, and its case study says Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology (CBIT) partnered with Qubrid AI for the research project. | named_customers.0: The homepage identifies Lern.Law in a customer testimonial from its Chief Revenue Officer. | named_customers.1: The case study says CBIT partnered with Qubrid AI; it expands CBIT as Chaitanya Bharathi Institute of Technology.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 16 employees as of 2026-01-29, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Qubrid’s contact page gives its headquarters address in McLean, Virginia. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly says Qubrid AI is headquartered in McLean, United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook identifies Qubrid AI and states its year founded as 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog archive/index shows mostly model comparisons, model availability, pricing, benchmarks, and API guides. It does not establish at least two engineer-authored posts about how Qubrid’s own product is built, so this does not qualify as an engineering blog under the stated test.

public_docs.notes: Qubrid exposes a public documentation portal with navigation to platform updates, model updates, and documentation resources, including a populated changelog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists a Full Stack AI Engineer role, which meets the question’s AI-role title criteria.

model_provider.value: The platform publicly offers inference access to models including DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, and GLM.
model_provider.notes: The product integration announcement names DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, and GLM; the model-updates page further identifies model-provider families such as Moonshot (Kimi) and Z.ai (GLM).

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Qubrid’s hosting page names “SOC Type 2” under its compliance/security claims; this corresponds to SOC 2. No other listed certification is asserted here. | compliance_certs.0: The cited Qubrid hosting page explicitly names SOC Type 2 in its compliance/security claims.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook’s latest completed round is labeled Angel (individual); the more recent Seed entry is marked upcoming rather than completed. | funding_date: PitchBook lists a completed Angel (individual) round dated 14-Jun-2024. Its later-listed $25M seed round is explicitly marked upcoming, so it is not a completed funding event.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest completed round shown is the June 2024 Angel round, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09; the $25M Seed listing is marked upcoming.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current company careers page lists engineering roles only (GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer), with no SDR, BDR, or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The platform changelog labels Model Comparison a feature dated June 11, 2026, and Qubrid’s July 16, 2026 post announces live Kimi K3 API access. Both fall within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current team listing names two executives, Pranay Prakash and Ujjwal Rajbhandari. The cited appointment announcement for Rajbhandari is from April 2024, before the queried 12-month window; no in-window executive change is established by the available team and announcement records.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Qubrid AI job listing explicitly names HubSpot and Zoho in its CRM-maintenance duties. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job listing explicitly names HubSpot as a CRM to maintain and update. | crm_stack_signal.1: The same job listing explicitly names Zoho as a CRM to maintain and update.
